H1.claim: The pathway to primacy conditions outcomes more than the endpoint itself
H1.headline: median scored outcome separates by 0.85 sd, 2.3x the reserve channel; exception: Indo-Pacific allies at 0.36 sd

statistics.definition: max median gap over mean within-pathway sd, 2035 endpoints; scored outcomes are the three allied tiers and the allied share of world spending (responses, not drivers); primary criterion is the median scored outcome exceeding twice the reserve-channel separation, with the minimum outcome reported as the strict robustness reading

H2.claim: American retrenchment moves allied budgets harder than Chinese growth alone
H2.headline: the US coefficient exceeds the China coefficient in absolute size in all three tiers (one-sided p 0.22 to 0.35); the 2025 episode shows substitution, US -7.5 percent against NATO Europe +15.6 percent

H3.claim: Reserve composition moves late and least among the commercial channels
H3.headline: renminbi settles 3.1% of payments but holds 1.99% of reserves (gap 1.11 pp, 2026-06); USD pathway separation 0.36 sd

drift_regimes.description: Mean quarterly share change, pp, before and after 2022-Q1; the difference is the regime shift replayed after a demonstration event
